name: Instrument Leg 7
definition: Additionnal details related to the leg.

LegSide.name: Leg Side
LegSide.definition: Coded list to specify the side of the trade leg.

LegSettlementType.name: Leg Settlement Type
LegSettlementType.definition: Specifies the date of settlement, in coded form.

LegSettlementDate.name: Leg Settlement Date
LegSettlementDate.definition: Specifies the date and time on which the trade will be settled.

LegSettlementCurrency.name: Leg Settlement Currency
LegSettlementCurrency.definition: Settlement currency of trade leg, agreed by both sides of the trade.

LegOrderQuantity.name: Leg Order Quantity
LegOrderQuantity.definition: Amount of trade leg in trading currency.

LegForwardPoints.name: Leg Forward Points
LegForwardPoints.definition: Forward points added to last spot rate. May be a negative value. Expressed in decimal form.

LegCalculatedCounterpartyCurrencyLastQua.name: Leg Calculated Counterparty Currency Last Quantity
LegCalculatedCounterpartyCurrencyLastQua.definition: Used for the calculated quantity of the other side of the currency trade. Can be derived from leg order quantity and leg last price.

LegRiskAmount.name: Leg Risk Amount
LegRiskAmount.definition: Measurement of the leg trade values in terms of a currency (for example, the amount of trade in US dollars).

LegValuationRate.name: Leg Valuation Rate
LegValuationRate.definition: Specifies the valuation rate used for the trade leg.

LegValueDate.name: Leg Value Date
LegValueDate.definition: Specifies the value date of leg spot transaction.

LegSecurityIdentification.name: Leg Security Identification
LegSecurityIdentification.definition: Security identification of the leg trade.
